definitions.orders: row count (one row = one single-line order)
definitions.delivered_value: sum booked_amount_inr where status=DELIVERED (refunds not subtracted again)
definitions.shipping_fees: sum shipping_fee_inr, reported separately; excluded from booked/refunds
definitions.aov: sum booked / order count of the same population
definitions.return_rate_of_all_orders_pct: RETURNED orders / all orders x 100 (secondary view)
definitions.avg_delivery_days_delivered: mean delivery_days over DELIVERED rows only
definitions.mom_change_pct: (booked this month - booked prior month) / booked prior month x 100
definitions.exception_rule: month x region cell with return rate > overall return rate + 1.5 percentage points
definitions.rounding: money and rates rounded half-up to 2 dp; rates are percentages
